Requirement Description: Raw billing data must be valid (no blanks, duplicates, invalid values)
Feature Store must be generated correctly from raw data
Feature Store values must match raw data values
Expected Outcome: Feature Store values equal raw data values

Requirement Description: Feature Store must update when raw data changes
Expected Outcome: Updated values reflected in Feature Store

Requirement Description: Missing values in raw data must be handled according to business rules
Expected Outcome: Missing values handled (Error, Blank, or Default)

Requirement Description: Duplicate customer records must not exist in Feature Store
Expected Outcome: No duplicates present; defect raised if found

Requirement Description: AI model must consume Feature Store, not raw data
AI predictions must change when feature values change
Defects must be documented with proper severity and reproducible steps
Expected Outcome: Defect logged with Title, Steps, Expected vs Actual, Severity
